song.title: Running a Monopoly
song.description: A five-dollar breakfast empire. A Monopoly app. A stomach staging a hostile takeover. Satirical hip-hop freestyle by Call Me Daddy.

lyrics.text:
Just hit McDonald's breakfast,
runnin' Monopoly on their app.
I gotta take a crap.
But I scored a wicked deal
even though the drive-thru was long.
I got a medium green tea, two
of the potato patties,
a chicken McMuffin with no cheese.
And I got all of this for five dollars.
I'm ecstatic.
But it's getting problematic 'cause
I'm gonna grab some sleeping bags
10 minutes north of Sylvan Lake.
I'm still in the parking lot
after I filled my belly with my food
and before I go to buy these
sleeping sacks, sleeping bags, I mean,
my gut is gettin' stomachy.
Think I gotta take a shit but I'm
not sure that I'm gonna do it lovely
'cause I'm still living in a van
and sometimes you gotta use the can
but since I can't squat low, sit, or stand,
my mobility has been damned.
I used to be able to bend,
used to be able to touch my toes.
Now I can hardly clean without
busting out my belly through these clothes.
So anyway,
I ain't about to write this shit down
before turning it into music
so I opened Suno on the app
and told that motherfucker, do this.
So we're gonna see if this works and
my bars turn into music
or if I'll have to roll back to the drive-thru,
run it back and
order some more McDonald's
so I can take a big McShit.
Just hit McDonald's breakfast,
runnin' Monopoly on their app.
Pass GO, collect my hash,
then I gotta take a crap.
But I scored a wicked deal
even though the drive-thru was long.
I got a medium green tea, two
of the potato patties,
a chicken McMuffin with no cheese.
And I got all of this for five dollars.
I'm ecstatic.
Big boss on a budget.
But it's getting problematic 'cause
I'm gonna grab some sleeping bags
10 minutes north of Sylvan Lake.
I'm still in the parking lot
after I filled my belly with my loot
and before I go to buy these
sleeping sacks, sleeping bags, I mean,
my gut is gettin' stomachy.
Think I gotta take a shit but I'm
not sure that I'm gonna do it lovely
'cause I'm still living in a van—
no property, still the fuckin' man.
Sometimes you gotta use the can,
but since I can't squat low, sit, or stand,
my mobility has been damned.
I used to be able to bend,
used to be able to touch my toes.
Now I can hardly clean without
busting out my belly through these clothes.
Got beef with my bowels,
they collecting what I owe.
Drew a Chance, tried to fart—
that's a gamble, bro.
So anyway,
I ain't about to write this shit down
before turning it into music
so I opened Suno on the app
and told that motherfucker, do this.
So we're gonna see if this works and
my bars turn into music
or if I'll have to roll back to the drive-thru,
run it back and
order some more McDonald's—
Free Parking, paid for it in pain.
Get Out of Jail Free,
but I'm locked up in this stall again.
